subject: Quick 15-min technical compatibility check before demo
messages:
From: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@storix.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2027-11-07T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Quick technical compatibility check before demo

Hi Vanessa,

We signed up for Redwood last week and kicked the tires with a small POC. Before we book a full product demo with your AE, our infra team wants a short 15-minute technical compatibility check to make sure there aren't any blockers (VPC/private deployment questions, token retention, and expected latency on our data volumes).

Context: we're Storix (retail analytics), evaluating private deployment in a VPC. Our initial throughput target is ~15 qps for short-chat flows and occasional long-form generation. Key concerns: network egress to your hosted API vs Private VPC options, and whether prefix/KV caching can be used with our prompt structure.

Preferred times this week:
- Tue 11/09 between 10:00-12:00 PT
- Wed 11/10 14:00-16:00 PT

Attaching a short infra summary (storix-infra-summary.pdf). Can you loop in an engineer for the 15-min call? If we get a clean triage, we'll schedule the full demo with your AE.

Thanks,
Sophie Lane
Head of Platform
Storix

Attachment: storix-infra-summary.pdf (application/pdf, 180KB)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@storix.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-11-07T09:38:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick technical compatibility check before demo

Hi Sophie — great to meet you and thanks for the infra summary.

We can absolutely do a short 15-minute triage. I've looped in Ben (solutions engineer) and Karthik (infra engineer) so they can join and give quick guidance.

Two fast options that work for the team:
- Tue 11/09 at 10:30 PT
- Wed 11/10 at 14:30 PT

If either works, please accept a quick Calendly invite: https://calendly.com/vanessa-ortiz/15min (I can also send a calendar invite directly).

Prep for the call (very short):
- One sample prompt or use-case you want to test
- Confirmation whether traffic will route to Redwood-hosted API or a Private VPC initially

I'm attaching a one-page triage checklist to speed things up: redwood-15min-checklist.pdf.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
SDR, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-15min-checklist.pdf (application/pdf, 32KB)
From: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@storix.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: Robert Chang <r.chang@storix.com>
Date: 2027-11-07T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick technical compatibility check before demo

Thanks Vanessa — 10:30 PT on Tue (11/09) works for us. I've added Robert (infra lead) to the thread.

Two quick clarifications ahead of the call:
1) We plan to test with your hosted API initially, with a plan to move to Private VPC for production. Does Redwood's KV/prefix caching behave differently across hosted vs private deployments?
2) Are there any firewall rules or IP allowlist entries we should prepare for a short triage (or will this be purely over the public endpoint)?

If we need a deeper follow-up after the triage we'll book a 45-min session with engineering — this is purely to triage obvious blockers.

Looking forward to Tuesday.

Best,
Sophie

Hi Sophie and Robert — confirmed for Tue 11/09 10:30 PT. I'll send a calendar invite out in a minute.

Quick note so the call is efficient:
- We'll spend 5–7 minutes reviewing your infra summary + the sample prompt.
- If you can paste one short prompt into the calendar invite or chat, we'll use that for a latency/throughput estimate.
- Common checklist: expected avg token length, whether you rely on long retriever contexts, and whether KV cache will store user-specific prefixes.

If there are any firewall constraints, flag them in the invite and we'll use the public endpoint for the triage and outline steps for a private/VPC test later.

Invite: (event sent) — please accept.
